visualCharacteristics.purpose: full-bleed lifestyle banner with an overlapping white strip of 3 icon + label benefit links
visualCharacteristics.structure: banner image + overlapping row of 3 icon/label links

contentPattern.structure: row 1 (optional) = single cell with the banner image; row 2 = one cell per benefit, each an icon image + linked label (typically 3). A single-cell image-only first row is treated as the banner; without it the benefits render on their own
